purpose: Private scientific research, preparation only; no fitting, rewriting, raw redistribution, paid APIs, or remote writes
acquisition: Exactly pinned raw.githubusercontent.com URLs; binary streams; one same-URL retry only on timeout if total actual payload budget permits. No substitution, redirects, compression, or downloaded executable code
schema: Retain raw files. Join by source_ID, never source order. Audit missing/duplicate IDs, source/model fields, cross-file ID sets, exact prompt and human equality, null/non-string/empty/whitespace arms. Stop before split on unresolved ambiguous IDs or unequal shared content
human_arm: One logical human observation per unique source_ID; two stored releases are provenance, not two humans
grouping_normalization: NFKC, casefold, remove all Unicode whitespace. Grouping view only; raw and decoded original text are never rewritten
grouping_edges: Exact normalized prompt equality links families; nonempty only
Exact normalized whole-answer equality across every arm links families; nonempty only
Exact normalized original blank-line block equality across every arm links families when block has at least 80 normalized Unicode characters
Near question: normalized prompt >=12 characters, character 3-gram set Jaccard >=0.80
Near answer: normalized answer >=50 characters, character 5-gram set Jaccard >=0.80
near_copy_algorithm: Exact prefix-filter set-similarity join at threshold 0.80, with global gram frequency order, set-size bound and exact verification; not approximate LSH. Grams represented by 64-bit BLAKE2b values; candidate positives reverified on original string-gram sets to eliminate hash-collision false positives. No arbitrary candidate cap; if resource limit reached, no frozen split
near_copy_limitations: Operational lexical-copy audit, not semantic equivalence or a proof of absence of paraphrase/short substring overlap. Does not claim exhaustive arbitrary-substring containment detection
contamination: Verify both old 128-row file prefixes against old manifest hashes and exact bytes. Mark their union of IDs and every connected component touching them development-exposed; train/dev only, never fresh test

structural_support.sentence_proxy: Nonempty spans ending at Chinese/Latin sentence punctuation or final text tail; punctuation retained with original offsets; proxy not linguistic gold
structural_support.line: At least two nonempty CR/LF-separated original lines
structural_support.paragraph: At least two nonempty original blank-line-separated blocks; proxy not rhetorical gold
structural_support.retrospective_discourse: At least two sentence-proxy units supports ordered-prose inspection, not validated rhetorical labels; no strict 8-unit gate or online-forecast claim
structural_support.missingness: Null/empty arm is missing. Unavailable paragraph/order views are missing, not zero measurements; no synthetic paragraph reconstruction

split: Deterministic SHA-256 order of component membership ID digest plus fixed seed. Strata by maximum human original character length in component: <200, 200-499, >=500. In each stratum, targets are rounded 20% test, rounded 20% dev, remainder train by COMPONENT COUNT; only unexposed groups eligible for test. Allocate test first, dev from remaining hash order, train remainder. If support/constraints prevent target, report actual counts, never tune seed or threshold. Family counts may deviate from 60/20/20
test_panels: After full component split, hash-order test components within each length stratum and alternate seen-generator and generator-transfer panels. Primary fitting/tuning protocol may use only human+ChatGPT from train/dev. Davinci excluded from all model/measurement fitting and tuning; transfer panel uses unseen families. Both test panels are family-disjoint. Descriptive preparation/support audits are not outcome fitting; test texts must not be used to tune definitions
scope: Single broad Baike/Web QA domain and two early generator labels, one human answer per question. Author, per-row dates, exact generator snapshots and topic labels unknown. No author-voice, contemporary-model, topic-transfer, domain-transfer or causal generator-effect claims
rights: M4 authors' source table attributes Chinese source data to MIT; this is not a verified per-answer rights chain. No root release license observed in pinned tree. Preserve original source/model fields, dataset and paper attribution, unknown upstream author/date/rights; no blanket commercial-training clearance
public_outputs: Own code/protocol plus aggregates and whole-file hashes only. No raw text, examples, source_ID lists, per-sample values, individual text hashes, split/identity/edge manifests or numeric per-sample uploads
